summary: Based on your household of two adults with no children and about $1,169,600 in annual earned income, you do not appear to qualify for any of the ten programmes screened: SNAP, WIC, TANF, SSI, Medicaid, CHIP, EITC, the refundable Child Tax Credit, the ACA premium tax credit, or free/reduced-price school meals. Your income is far above the limits for all of them, and the child-based programmes do not apply without children in the home. This result does not depend on which state you live in. Your income is well above every threshold, so a caseworker review is not needed.
